items.html: And now we will explain the matter of Adam HaRishon at the time he was created, according to what our sages said in the Midrash and in the Talmud, how it connects with what we have explained. For behold, our rabbis said that the body of Adam HaRishon was created from the Land of Israel, and his buttocks from Babylon and from the swamp of Agma, etc. And in order to explain this, we must also explain what they said in the Book of Tikkunim: that in the Land of Israel Yetzira rules, while outside the Land Assiya rules. Therefore we will explain the matter of the distinction between the Land of Israel and outside the Land, Trans-Jordan, and Syria, etc. — what the meaning of all these aspects is. Behold, we have explained that then, before man was created, the worlds were higher in their degree.
